title: Global Signal Call
style: cinematic electronic world, 116 BPM, global percussion, electronic bass, building call-and-response, every continent energy, uplifting anthem, multi-regional feel, chantable hook, male vocal NZ/AU accent, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[INTRO — building signal tones]
Southeast Asia — here.
West Africa — here.
South America — here.
Western Australia — here.

[VERSE 1]
One signal — every timezone
One stack — every phone
MOSOKO in Manila
CoreyAI at home

ZYNCONTEXT carries the context
KERVALON checks the name
PLUGGED delivers the lesson
The signal's always the same

[CHORUS]
Global signal call — answer
Global signal call — dancer
Global signal call — every person
Global signal call — every version

[VERSE 2]
Not a translation layer
Not a language school
The transformation layer
That's the only rule

Human on the end of it
Human in the loop
Global signal calling
Everyone — regroup

[BRIDGE]
East to west — the signal travels
North to south — the context unravels
ZYNTHIO holds the thread
Global signal — not dead

[FINAL CHORUS]
Global signal call — 336
Global signal call — this is it
Global signal call — no missing
Global signal call — ZYNTHIO listening

[OUTRO — signal fades]
The signal was always global.
We just gave it a name.
